_source: Scope text quoted from EP 6.49 (discuss.ens.domains/t/22237). Milestones are PROVISIONAL: extracted from each provider's own SPP3 application, which is what they proposed, NOT the negotiated set in Award Notice Item 5. Every milestone carries a verbatim quote from its source document, and all 60 were verified as exact substrings of the fetched applications on 2026-08-06. They are unconfirmed by the committee and must be reconciled against Item 5 when the executed Award Notices reach the workspace.
_epoch_note: Reports are due within 30 days of each calendar quarter end (Program Terms clause 6.3). The public ENS Forum version is contractual, not a courtesy.

measurement_methodology.authority: [7.1] SPP3 Marketplace RFP + executed Nomentum award

q1_revenue.baseline_window: 90 days immediately before Award Notice signing

term_secondary_volume.method: Sum completed ENS secondary-sale consideration attributable to Grails after anti-wash filters and minimum-value rules.

term_secondary_volume.anti_wash_policy: required by RFP but exact filter parameters are not public
term_secondary_volume.minimum_value_rule: required by RFP but exact threshold is not public
term_secondary_volume.status: method partially defined; committee must publish/freeze anti-wash and minimum-value parameters before scoring

data_continuity_note.observed_conflict: ENS.Tools published on 2026-07-19 that Grails was winding down; the DAO subsequently awarded Nomentum Labs funding to operate and develop Grails in September 2026.
data_continuity_note.treatment: Do not assume pre-award API continuity proves post-award operation. Gate measurements must use dated events inside the contractual measurement window and independently verifiable settlement/attribution data.

namespace.scope: ENSv2 migration of their on-chain subname stack, continued maintenance of existing tooling, and business development.
namespace.why_funded: One of the ecosystem's primary subname infrastructure teams: SDKs, APIs, CCIP gateways, and custom deployments including Celo, Filecoin and Rootstock. The award reflects the counterfactual: no comparable subname infrastructure exists at this scale, and the ENSv2 transition makes that work time-critical.
namespace.watch: SPP2 subname issuance exceeded target by more than an order of magnitude, but the committee noted that figure is concentrated in a small number of large deployments.
namespace.external_note: EP 6.49: key milestones depend on ENSv2 shipping to mainnet, and the committee accounted for this in the negotiated milestone structure. A slip here is not a delivery failure.

goldsky.scope: Operate ENS indexing as a dedicated public service (with eRPC), at the expanded scope presented as Option B in their application.
goldsky.why_funded: Indexing is a shared dependency consumed across the ecosystem and had previously been funded inside larger provider scopes. The committee's judgment is that a dependency of this weight is best held as a standalone mandate: one accountable owner, priced on its own merits.
goldsky.watch: New to the SPP and evaluated accordingly. Selection was conditioned on explicit commitment to the full Option B scope.
